integrity: Theorem proved analytically; finite symbolic and numerical tests are supplementary. Prior work is credited for general nonpreservation of steady states under unbalanced Strang splitting.
scientific_limitations: Exact semidiscrete odd-power reaction-diffusion system on finite unweighted regular bipartite graphs; convergence classification is only on its invariant checkerboard line. No claims about transverse stability, arbitrary graph meshes, the full Allen–Cahn PDE, finite-precision propagation, or exhaustive bibliographic priority.
title: Sharp order-dependent stationary-pattern bias for Strang splitting on bipartite reaction–diffusion graphs
